text: The Maharashtra International Sports University Act, 2020. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202035 Act Number: 35 Enactment Date: 2020-12-28 Act Year: 2020 Short Title: The Maharashtra International Sports University Act, 2020. Long Title: An Act to establish and incorporate an International Sports University, Maharashtra in the State of Maharashtra, a specialized University first of its kind, to create competent personnel in sports, to promote physical education and sports education in the areas of sports sciences, sports medicine, sports technology, sports governing, sports management, sports media and communication, sports coaching and training, besides functioning as the State training center for select sports disciplines by adopting best international practices and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
